summary: Critical Metals Corp. (filer) filed Form 6-K announcing a binding Scheme Implementation Deed to acquire all shares and listed options of European Lithium Ltd. by two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement. European Lithium shareholders will receive 0.035 Critical Metals shares per share held; listed options will be exchanged for shares based on a 20-day VWAP minus exercise price; ZEPOs are either cancelled for shares or swapped for economically equivalent securities with same vesting conditions. No vote by Critical Metals shareholders is required. Completion conditions include European Lithium's shareholder approval and net cash/liquid assets of at least AUD$330M. The transaction is expected to close in H2 2026, followed by a scheme meeting in Q3 2026. Key risk-arb items include regulatory approval and the cash condition.
